name: OW-BIG-never-grown
old:
export const tvOwnGrow = (dist) =>
  Math.max(1, Math.min(TV_OWN_GROW_MAX, Math.round((Number.isFinite(dist) ? dist : 0) / TV_OWN_GROW_M)));
note: The traveller is a speck from the Overworld.

name: OW-BIG-grow-ignored
note: The view's step reaches the sprite and is thrown away.

name: OW-BIG-giant-shadow
old: batch.noShadow = grow > 1;   // AUDIT OW5 R2: OW-BIG's giant casts NOTHING - selfCard off was never that (render/shadowPass.js: it only keeps the card out of the lamps' maps when it is not the player's own; the sun's cascades drew the tenfold card, a fifty-metre shadow at a low sun, and the lamps' maps baked it)
new: batch.noShadow = false;   // AUDIT OW5 R2: OW-BIG's giant casts NOTHING - selfCard off was never that (render/shadowPass.js: it only keeps the card out of the lamps' maps when it is not the player's own; the sun's cascades drew the tenfold card, a fifty-metre shadow at a low sun, and the lamps' maps baked it)
note: The grown sprite casts a giant's shadow across the land (AUDIT OW5 R2: re-aimed from selfCard, which never kept it from casting).

name: OW-BIG-self-card
old: batch.selfCard = grow === 1;   // The player's own body - it casts as drawn, into the maps redrawn every frame (render/shadowPass.js SELF CARD); OW-BIG: a grown one casts no giant's shadow
new: batch.selfCard = true;   // The player's own body - it casts as drawn, into the maps redrawn every frame (render/shadowPass.js SELF CARD); OW-BIG: a grown one casts no giant's shadow
note: The grown card is taken for the player's own at the lamps.

name: OW-BIG-lantern-adrift
old: if (grow === 1) drawLantern();   // The lantern at the waist, its own billboard, after the body - OW-BIG: a grown body's waist is not where the lantern hangs
new: drawLantern();   // The lantern at the waist, its own billboard, after the body - OW-BIG: a grown body's waist is not where the lantern hangs
note: The lantern hangs at a grown body's old waist.

name: OW-BIG-no-step

new: grow: 1, // OW-BIG: the traveller's sprite, grown with the eye's distance
note: The view never hands the host its step.
